newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila waterworks chief tenders resignation.
newsitem.headline: Manila waterworks chief tenders resignation.

text.p: The administrator of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage system (MWSS) has tendered his "irrevocable resignation" to President Fidel Ramos, Executive Secretary Ruben Torres said on Saturday.
Torres told reporters President Fidel Ramos was still reviewing the resignation offer of MWSS chief Angel Lazaro.
"The President is evaluating the situation because it's only a matter of a few months when the privatisation of the MWSS in July...will be completed," Torres said.
Torres said Lazaro tendered his resignation effective April 1 to return to the private sector.
Lazaro led government efforts to privatise Manila's waterworks system early this year.
The government had offered two 25-year concessions to run the city's waterworks system.
The consortium of Ayala Corp, Bechtel Corp of the United States and United Utilities won the east zone concession.
The west zone was won by Benpres Holdings with France's Lyonnaise des Eaux SA.
